auth.title: Welcome
auth.subtitle: Please log in to continue.
auth.defaultPasswordBanner: You are still using the first password that came with the system. Please change it to keep your data safe.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Company details, rates and your password.

company.title: Company information
company.description: Shown on reports and at the top of the screen.
company.name: Company name

payroll.title: Salary rates
payroll.description: Used when salaries are calculated. Change only if the law or your rules change.
payroll.dailyStandardHours: Normal working hours in a day

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: How many days before an expiry date (insurance, licences, bonds) you want a reminder.
reminders.daysBefore: Remind me this many days before

billing.title: Billing defaults
billing.description: Default values for new projects. Each project can still have its own values.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Use at least 8 characters. Write it down somewhere safe.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Here is a quick look at your business.
dashboard.notYet: Will show once data is entered
dashboard.nothingNeedsAttention: Nothing needs your attention right now.

clients.title: Clients
clients.subtitle: The people and offices you work for.
clients.formDescription: Government office, school society, company or private person.
clients.empty: No clients yet. Add the first one.
clients.deleteConfirm: Delete the client "{name}"? It will be hidden from lists, but kept in the history.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: All your sites and contracts.
projects.addSubtitle: Fill in what you know now. You can change it later.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Add your first project.
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete the project "{name}"? It will be hidden from lists, but kept in the history.

sections.basicHint: Name, type and who the work is for.
sections.contractHint: Contract value, retention and advance. Retention starts with your billing settings.

fields.name: Project name
fields.progressHint: Only for projects without a BOQ.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: How much you expect to spend on each part of the work. Only you see this.

projects.costsHelp: Expenses of this project. The full cost picture (labour, materials, machines) comes in a later update.

team.help: Bookings from today for two weeks. Change them on the Schedule.

workers.title: Workers
workers.subtitle: Everyone who works for you, with their pay.
workers.addSubtitle: The starting pay is saved as the first pay rate.
workers.empty: No workers yet. Add the first one.
workers.deleteConfirm: Delete the worker "{name}"? They will be hidden from lists, but kept in the history.

sections.startingPayHint: Later pay changes are added under "Pay rates".

fields.nicHint: Old (851234567V) or new (198512345678). Leave empty if not known.
fields.typeHint: Daily paid: paid for each day worked. Permanent: monthly salary with EPF / ETF.
fields.activeHint: Turn off when the worker leaves. Their history is kept.
fields.otHint: Leave empty to calculate it from the normal pay.

rates.title: Pay rate history
rates.description: The pay on any day is the latest rate that started on or before that day.
rates.addDescription: For a pay rise or change. Older rates are kept for past salaries.
rates.otHint: Leave empty to calculate it from the normal pay.
rates.deleteConfirm: Delete the pay rate starting {date}? Use this only to remove a mistake.

assets.title: Machines & Vehicles
assets.subtitle: Machines, vehicles and tools, with their papers.
assets.addSubtitle: Vehicles get reminders for licence, insurance and other papers.
assets.empty: No machines or vehicles yet. Add the first one.
assets.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It will be hidden from lists, but kept in the history.

sections.meterHint: Machines are serviced by engine hours, vehicles by kilometres. The rates are used for project costs.

fields.name: Name
fields.isVehicleHint: Suggests revenue licence, insurance, emission test and fitness documents.

usage.title: Usage log
usage.help: Usage is recorded on the Daily Entry page.

maintenance.title: Service & repairs
maintenance.empty: No service or repair recorded yet.
maintenance.serviceHint: A service resets the service counter at this reading.

allocations.title: Bookings
allocations.help: Bookings from last week to next month. Change them on the Schedule.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.subtitle: Shops, dealers and subcontractors you buy from.
suppliers.formDescription: A shop, dealer, fuel station or subcontractor.
suppliers.empty: No suppliers yet. Add the first one.
suppliers.deleteConfirm: Delete the supplier "{name}"? It will be hidden from lists, but kept in the history.

statement.title: Statement
statement.help: Only credit purchases and credit expenses add to what we owe. Cash purchases are already paid.

purchases.title: Purchases & Store
purchases.subtitle: What you buy, what is in the store, and the list of materials.
purchases.formDescription: One bill from a supplier. Each item goes to the main store or straight to a project.

materials.formDescription: Materials you buy, like cement, sand or steel.
materials.empty: No materials yet. Add the first one.
materials.deleteConfirm: Delete the material "{name}"? It will be hidden from lists, but kept in the history.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Company papers and every document in the system.
documents.companyHint: Company papers such as the CIDA registration, certificates and insurance.
documents.empty: No documents yet. Upload the first one.
documents.noPreview: This file cannot be shown here. Download it to open it.
documents.deleteConfirm: Delete the document "{title}"? It will be hidden, but its files are kept.

fields.title: Title
fields.expiryHint: You will get a reminder before this date.

upload.title: Upload a document
upload.description: Choose the file, then say what it is. Dates are optional.
upload.dropHere: Drop a file here, or click to choose one
upload.allowed: PDF, photos, Word / Excel, drawings or ZIP — up to {mb} MB

version.title: Upload a new version
version.description: The new file becomes the current version of "{title}". Older versions stay in the history.

history.title: Version history
history.restoreText: A copy of this version becomes the newest version. Nothing is deleted.
history.restored: The old version is current again.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Plan who and which machine works where. Nobody can be booked twice at the same time.
schedule.assignTeamHelp: Book several workers to one project for one or more days.
schedule.assignMachinesHelp: Book several machines to one project for one or more days.
schedule.help: Click an empty day to book someone. Click a coloured block to change or cancel it.
schedule.cancelConfirm: Cancel this booking? The time becomes free again.

conflict.title: Already booked
conflict.description: Someone is already booked at that time, so nothing was saved.
conflict.hint: Choose another time or another person, or change the existing booking first.

daily.title: Daily Entry
daily.subtitle: Record a day at a site: who came, machine hours and fuel, and money spent.
daily.loadFailed: This day could not be loaded. Please try again.
daily.copyNothing: No earlier day with attendance was found.
daily.noWorkers: Nobody is planned for this day. Add a worker above.
daily.alreadyAt: Already marked at {project} on this day
daily.attendanceHelp: People planned on the Schedule are listed here. Rows without a choice are not saved.
daily.noMachines: No machines are planned. Add one above if a machine worked here.

totals.halfDays: {n, plural, one {# half day} other {# half days}}

daily.locked: Salaries for this month are finalized, so this day can no longer be changed.
daily.otherProjectError: Already marked at another project on this day: {names}

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Money spent at sites and in the office.
expenses.formDescription: Leave the project empty for office or general costs.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.help: Attendance is recorded on the Daily Entry page.

advances.title: Salary advances
advances.formDescription: Money given before payday. It is taken back from the salary.
advances.recoveryHint: How much to take back from each month's salary. Leave empty to take it all at once.
advances.help: Once part of an advance is taken back from a salary, it can no longer be changed.

store.issueDescription: Send material from the main store to a project. Its cost moves to that project.
store.notEnough: Not enough in the store. Only {available} {unit} left.
store.stockHelp: Materials bought for the main store and not yet sent to a site.
store.emptyStock: The store is empty. Purchases delivered to the main store show here.
store.undoConfirm: Undo this issue? The quantity goes back to the store.

payroll.subtitle: Salaries of daily and permanent workers.
payroll.comingSoon: Salary calculation comes in the next update. The advances given so far are listed below.
